tools.name: read_study_summary
tools.description: Return the study's published totals, presence gains and losses, official-link changes, and per-view counts. Use for aggregate questions about this specific study and its methodology.

tools.name: read_engine_view
tools.description: Return the published comparison count, brand-presence change count and rate for one exact engine view. Engine-specific official-link counts are unavailable in the public dataset.

tools.name: compare_engine_views
tools.description: Compare the published brand-presence change rates of two engine views in the VisibilityOS study. Return both denominators and the first rate minus the second in percentage points.
